name: Stuck with you
source:
[i]I’m stuck with him. Or rather, I’ve stuck myself to him.
I can’t even tell who’s more dependent on the other at this point.[/i]

A late night conversation between two best friends. 

[From [url=https://teletuu.itch.io/stuck-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]我被他困住了。或者更确切地说，我已经把自己粘在他身上了。
此时我什至无法判断谁更依赖另一个。[/i]

两个最好的朋友之间的深夜谈话。

[来自[url=https://teletuu.itch.io/stuck-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
